CPWD DELHI ANALYSIS OF RATES -2012 (WITH FORMULAS)
Notes : | 01. This entire work is done by me alone and every item is compared with DSR-2012 and DAR-2012
02. At the end of each item the DSR-2012 rate is shown, so that it is easy to compare both the rates.
03. DSR rate in 'Green' means it is tallied with Analysed rate.
04. DSR rate in 'Red' means it is not tallied with Analysed rate but the analysed rate is tallied with that of DAR-2012.
05. Where sub analysis is involved the analysed rate will not tally exactly to that of DAR-2012 because, in DAR every rate is rounded-off. But in this analysis, I have not rounded-off to nearest 5 np. But both the rates are very close.
06. Where ever there is an error in DAR (only a few items this time) it is mentioned in the item it self.
07. Please let me know, if I am violating any copy right, so that I can delete the post from internet.
If any one want to share some thing about this analysis with me, they are welcome! Please do mail me on rambabujalli@gmail.com. Even a small comment will boost my enthusiasm to work more….
Sincerely yours

Rambabu Jalli,
SDE(Civil), BSNL,
Hyderabad.
